gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: Both exact ZIP hashes passed archive checks. Candidate had 0 invalid actions in 12 episodes, import/create under 1 s, reset under 1 ms, max act under 35 ms and peak RSS under 302 MB; no inference map or simulator state was added.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: The opening gas gate activated 120 times across 12 episodes, always exited at image-speed 34, and increased mean first-10-percent gas from 0.0847 to 0.1791. Median first-10-percent arrival fell from 3.68 s to 2.72 s on matched tune cells.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Candidate and control both finished 12/12 fresh tune cells; candidate median lap was 23.85 s versus 25.02 s, with no added collisions or damage. Independent held-out and unchanged-package confirmation have not been run; this diagnostic profile is ineligible for SOTA promotion.
